header: A picture is answered only to a page that shows it (my rule: no photograph can be saved from this app; see src/lib/ui/imageGuard.ts for what that can and cannot mean). The public picture files (the DSP history pictures and the other image files in /public) and Next's image optimiser are the only paths this runs on. A browser that loads the picture into a page sends `Sec-Fetch-Dest: image` and is served; one that is asked to open the picture by itself (the address typed, "Open image in new tab", "Save link as") sends `document` and gets 403. The employees' photographs have their own route, which applies the same rule after its login check.
